02247 chabah {kha:-va:'}

字根型 [比較 02245]; TWOT - 590; 動詞

欽定本 - hide... 5; 5

1) 隱匿, 退出

   1b) (Niphal) 自我隱藏
record.edic_text:
02247 chabah {khaw-bah'}

a primitive root [compare 02245]; TWOT - 590; v

AV - hide... 5; 5

1) to withdraw, hide, hide oneself
   1a) (Qal) to withdraw
   1b) (Niphal) to hide oneself, remain hidden, withdraw
